text: A Fire dominance adds momentum and forward drive. Action feels clarifying: you understand yourself best through movement and visible progress.
When balanced, this creates courage and initiative. When unbalanced, it can tilt toward impatience or burnout.
An Earth dominance emphasizes practicality and grounded decision-making. Stability, structure and tangible results matter deeply.
When resourced, this builds reliability and competence. Under stress, it may harden into rigidity or over-control.
microRecs: Create visible milestones rather than endless refinement

text: An Air dominance highlights perspective, dialogue and conceptual thinking. You process life through ideas and conversation.
Balanced, this brings adaptability and insight. When strained, it can become over-analysis or detachment.
microRecs: Move decisions from thought to action within clear time limits
Practice naming feelings without over-explaining them

text: A Water dominance deepens emotional awareness and relational sensitivity. Meaning is felt before it is explained.
In strength, this creates empathy and intuitive understanding. Under stress, it may slide into overwhelm or withdrawal.
Cardinal energy initiates. You are wired to begin, push forward, and create momentum.
The growth edge is sustaining energy beyond the launch phase.
watchOut: Starting more than you can finish

text: Fixed energy stabilizes and protects what matters. You bring persistence and depth.
The growth edge is flexibility without feeling destabilized.
microRecs: Introduce controlled change in small increments

text: Mutable energy adapts and integrates. You adjust quickly and read context well.
The growth edge is choosing direction instead of endlessly adapting.
